correctness.rationale: The tested equation is composition of a k-linear map with itself, not the element equation. Applying L_x twice to e_j gives x_j times weighted two-walk sums; independent support kills the intermediate weights. An occupied edge u-v produces the entry (w,u) from the unique common neighbor v of distinct u,w if v has another neighbor w. This uniqueness uses absence of any four-cycle, including non-induced ones. Either endpoint can be used, and for an isolated edge the diagonal entry is x_u x_v. On C_4 the two distinct row neighborhoods are the opposite parity pairs; both have weight sum zero for (1,1,-1,-1), giving the stated counterexample. For a cycle, rank loss relative to support size equals the dimension of adjacency-kernel vectors supported there. The recurrence y_(i+2)=-y_i makes all nonzero odd-cycle kernel vectors full-support (possible only in characteristic two). On an even cycle the two parity chains close after n/2 steps, admitting a full-parity dependency precisely when (-1)^(n/2)=1. An independent support containing a whole parity class must equal that alternating class, so each such support loses exactly one rank. Marked cyclic gaps give n/j times binomial(n-j-1,j-1) for j>0 and the empty support contributes one; weighting by (q-1)^j and moving the two alternating terms gives the displayed correction and the C_6 examples. Isolated coefficients are counted with multiplicity as required. Field order already determines characteristic, so the final prose about holding cardinality fixed is vacuous; the substantive assertion is that the total needs only the independence polynomial evaluated at q-1, whereas the rank formula has a characteristic-dependent correction. In a separately written bounded check (python3 /workspace/check_cycle_gf4.py), direct double multiplication and image cardinalities on all 4^6 vectors give 1+18z+135z^2 over F_4, extending the recorded prime-field examples. Frozen checker and output were inspected, not rerun.

The unique-witness proof and four-cycle counterexample explain why the support reduction can fail rather than fitting a few examples. The cycle refinement identifies and quantifies rank losses that the total count cannot detect; it applies to all cycle sizes in scope and all finite fields.
